title: 652. Course Schedule III

examples.explanation: Take the first three courses (100 + 200 + 1000 = 1300 by day 1300); the 2000-long course cannot fit.
The single course finishes exactly on time.
Each course alone already misses its deadline.

hints: Order courses by deadline so earlier cutoffs are considered first.
Keep taken durations in a max-heap plus their running total.
When the total passes the current deadline, drop the longest taken course; the heap size at the end is the answer.
